arguments.subject: msp records
arguments.body:
Hi Michael,

The MSP and IT-services founders you sell hold years of ticket, monitoring and client records. After closing, those records tend to get archived or deleted, and some have value to technology and research buyers.

We run a free two-minute estimate that shows an owner what their business records could be worth. Nothing goes to a buyer without the owner's OK, and we can discuss a referral arrangement.

Would a one-paragraph summary you can forward be useful?

If this isn't relevant, reply "no" and I won't follow up.

Alex Starr
Mesa Data Labs
[postal address]
